blocker.summary: The current review cycle has exhausted its repair-wave budget.

findings.failure_condition: P1: StreamingRecordDeduplicator::observe (559-574) treats every record wholly behind the byte frontier as Duplicate without comparing payload, ordinal or parse_error. A conflicting record at an already accepted source position is discarded before diagnostics and promotion summary observe it (603-610). With otherwise complete valid records, overlap_conflict remains false and Canonical/ForwardAppend can still be published despite the conflict.
findings.required_behavior: Deduplicate only proven-identical overlap; preserve or reject conflicting payload, ordinal and parse diagnostics and prevent canonical completeness/ForwardAppend promotion. Keep raw-record residency bounded and add a conflicting-overlap negative control alongside exact-duplicate equality.

findings.failure_condition: P2: The cumulative delta adds boundary_scan_honors_cancellation_after_io_has_started at lines 1674-1697 inside production source. The confirmed decision closes persistent test admission to four named assets and explicitly excludes new test assets in production source; allowing implementation edits to this file does not authorize this new persistent test.
findings.required_behavior: Restore the confirmed persistent-test boundary, keeping necessary cancellation-after-I/O evidence in admitted test assets or obtaining explicit admission before retaining a new production-source test. Preserve the working cancellation/deadline control checks.
